chunks: If any of you takes a pebble from the mosque, then let him return it to its place or to another mosque, for indeed it glorifies Allah.

key_terms.أَبُو جَعْفَرٍ: Abu Ja‘far, Imam Muhammad ibn Ali al-Baqir عليه السلام
key_terms.الْمَسْجِدِ: the mosque, a sacred place of worship

ai.seo_question: What should a person do if they remove a pebble from a mosque?
ai.summary: This hadith teaches reverence for the mosque and respect for even the smallest things connected to it. It indicates that what belongs to the mosque should be returned, and it highlights the sanctity of the mosque by stating that even a pebble therein glorifies Allah.
